open SimpleGraph

theorem Opn.total_coloring_conjecture :
    ∀ {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj],
      G.totalChromaticNumber ≤ G.maxDegree + 2 := by
  sorry
